comments.note: No blocking issues. The new setItemsPerPageURLTemplate(string): self method on GridPagination is clean and follows all project conventions: fluent return type, properly initialized private nullable property, clear docblock. The getter correctly prefers the explicit template over the auto-computed sentinel-based one, preserving full backward compatibility with callers that never call the setter.

Security check passed: the URL template flows through json_encode() in BaseGridRenderer::createItemsPerPageSelector() before being written into the onchange JS attribute. Any special characters in the template are escaped at that point, preventing XSS.

Future plan authors should verify whether methods referenced in test code already exist in production before tagging a WP as test-only to avoid this surprise scope expansion.
